name: Anime Festival Asia (Indonesia)
blurb: Indonesian edition of the Anime Festival Asia series, pairing a J-pop/anime night concert with an exhibition hall at ICE BSD City near Jakarta.
notes: The 10th AFA Indonesia ran 15-16 Aug 2026 (venue: Indonesia Convention Exhibition (ICE), BSD City, Hall 1 & 2), which already concluded before the 2026-10-05 research window. The site now marks it 'JUST COMPLETED!' and says 'Register your interest for the next AFA Indonesia!' with no future date shown anywhere on the page, so editions is left empty rather than guessed. ICE BSD City is in BSD City, South Tangerang, Banten — part of the Greater Jakarta metro area but not Jakarta city itself, so city is recorded as 'Tangerang' rather than the given 'Jakarta' (the event itself is branded only as 'AFA Indonesia', with no city in its own name). Guests were not researched since there is no current/upcoming edition to attach a lineup to; resumed in 2024 after pausing after 2018 per the brief, now marketed as its '10th' edition.
